---
title: "Bienvenido"
---

Este sitio organiza soluciones de programacion competitiva por competencia, problema y tags.

## Problemas destacados

<div id="featured-problems" class="cp-grid"></div>
<p id="featured-empty" class="cp-empty" style="display:none;">Aun no hay problemas destacados. Marca metadato `featured: true` en una solucion para destacarla.</p>

## Contribuidores

<p>Lista dinamica obtenida desde GitHub.</p>
<div id="contributors" class="cp-grid"></div>
<p id="contributors-empty" class="cp-empty" style="display:none;">No se pudieron cargar contribuidores en este momento.</p>

<script>
(async function () {
	const featuredHost = document.getElementById("featured-problems");
	const featuredEmpty = document.getElementById("featured-empty");

	try {
		const response = await fetch("docs/problems/catalog.json");
		const catalog = await response.json();
		const featured = catalog.filter(item => item.featured);
		const selected = (featured.length ? featured : catalog).slice(0, 6);

		if (!selected.length) {
			featuredEmpty.style.display = "block";
		}

		for (const item of selected) {
			const card = document.createElement("article");
			card.className = "cp-card";
			card.innerHTML = `
				<h3><a href="docs/${item.url}">${item.problem_id}: ${item.title}</a></h3>
				<p>${item.competition}</p>
				<p>${(item.tags || []).map(tag => `<span class="cp-tag">${tag}</span>`).join(" ")}</p>
			`;
			featuredHost.appendChild(card);
		}
	} catch (_) {
		featuredEmpty.style.display = "block";
	}
})();

(async function () {
	const contributorsHost = document.getElementById("contributors");
	const contributorsEmpty = document.getElementById("contributors-empty");

	try {
		const response = await fetch("https://api.github.com/repos/clubalgoritmos/CompetitiveProgramming/contributors?per_page=30", {
			headers: { "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json" }
		});

		if (!response.ok) {
			throw new Error("GitHub API error");
		}

		const contributors = await response.json();
		for (const person of contributors) {
			const card = document.createElement("article");
			card.className = "cp-card cp-contributor";
			card.innerHTML = `
				<img src="${person.avatar_url}" alt="Avatar de ${person.login}" loading="lazy" />
				<h3><a href="${person.html_url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">@${person.login}</a></h3>
				<p>${person.contributions} contribuciones</p>
			`;
			contributorsHost.appendChild(card);
		}

		if (!contributors.length) {
			contributorsEmpty.style.display = "block";
		}
	} catch (_) {
		contributorsEmpty.style.display = "block";
	}
})();
</script>
